handlekey_uibattleimmortal_wanfashuoming.ch:
1. 你将受到法阵护盾的保护，一旦<r>失去护盾</r>将暴露在天劫的威能之中，<r>极其危险！</r>
2.  当法阵存在时，可以使用更多的回复丹药，且使用丹药的念力消耗降低，间隔<r>大幅缩短</r>，但<r>不可使用</r>提升攻防的丹药。
    渡过第一阶段后将融合部分法阵的力量，暂时使用仙力技能，此时法阵的效果将会解除。
3. 可以借助法阵沟通天地<r>使用法则之力</r>。长按ZL键完成蓄力后，松开按键即可使用。
    劫兽被你击杀时，法阵将储存飘逸出的法则之力。
4. 你需要激发体内的仙力来对抗天劫，此时将<r>无法移动，使用绝技、身法、神通及领域技能</r>。
5. 天劫随着时间推移将越来越猛烈，劫雷的威能巨大失去护盾的保护时可能导致<r>瞬间死亡</r>，<r>时刻</r>保证你的<r>体力全满</r>并坚持一段时间。

Sect features
 Sect duels and tryouts: compete with other disciples to join a sect or get a promotion.
 Sect Tournament: compete with elite disciples from other sects.
 Resource Points: attack, occupy, and defend them for bonus sect resources and accelerated sect store refreshes.
 Sect battle: attack other sects, and raid or destroy them.
 Sect relocation: move your sect to the next area.
Sect buildings
 Mission Hall: sect missions of various types added.
 Council Hall: optimized display and information on sect resources and logs.
 Treasure Pavilion: type of items expanded.
 Manual Library: allowed sect leaders to change the sect's main Martial Arts.
 Spirit Pavilion: originally known as Cultivation Chamber, providing exclusive Rewrite Destinies if made breakthrough in it.
 Behemoth Peaks: allowed interaction with the sect's divine beast and conversion of Spiritual Fruits.
Adventures and Plots
 Truth Seeker, Sage Tianxuan's Confusion, Journey of You Yuanzhi, Mysterious Go Players, Jo's Treasure, Feather of Golden Crow, Magpie Zhehong.
New Feature: Heaven-chosen
 Heaven-chosen NPCs are granted with higher stats and skills.
 Heaven-chosen NPCs act with optimized AI behaviors.
 Heaven-chosen NPCs have Taoist Minds. Gaining Rewrite Destinies upon breakthrough requires a Taoist Mind.
Rewrite Destinies
 The World Together, Blade of Heaven's Eye, No Traces Left in Snow, Cloud-piercing Lightning, Borderless, Raging Flames, Tiger's Spirit and Dragon's Soul, Concealed Nirvana, Earth Shattering, Murderous Rise, Alchemic Taoist Perfection, Always Someone Better, Cold Divine Light, Wild Desert Blade, Regained Strength and Scattered Elements, Transmuted Strength, Golden Needle Point, Virtue and Acceptance, Medicine for Everyone, Fiery Bristle, King of Foxhill, Floating Illusion, Shadowchase Pill, Lightning Rumble, Quick Wit, Supernova Sword, King of Dark River.
Special Sect
 Dragon Mountain Hamlet.
Secret Order
 Taoist Mind Pavilion, Mindsnap Temple.
